definition_of_done: The absent-digest patch resolves once from observation, the executed patch binds to that digest, the configured check passes, and the workspace was mutated exactly once.

required.oracle: The controller-owned deterministic oracle scores task state, the executed patch's before_sha256 (the resolved digest bound to the original bytes), and the single mutation.

purpose: Prove an apply_patch step whose expected_sha256 is absent resolves the digest from observation exactly once and patches exactly the bytes the operator approved (D-8 Fix A / RC-1 on the Runtime driver the scorecard uses).
title: Absent-digest patch resolution
